result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. The carousels, chips and bottom-cut card are intentional and excluded. There is one clear navigation-state defect and a few minor styling and accessibility concerns.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights 'Profile' as the active tab, but the screen shown is the restaurant discovery/home feed. The active-state indicator does not match the content, so users are misled about where they are. 'Home' appears inactive.
issues.suggestion: Set the active tab to 'Home' on this screen, or show the Profile content if Profile is the intended destination.

issues.description: Low-contrast text: the gray delivery-fee captions (e.g. '€0.90 delivery'), the search placeholder, and the inactive nav labels are light gray on a light background. The white-on-green promo subtext over the lighter circular overlay is also weaker.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colors to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) and keep the promo text clear of the decorative overlay.

issues.description: The time badges on the 'Fastest near you' cards (e.g. '15–25 min') overlap the bottom-left edge of the image and sit close to the card corner. On the first card the white badge blends into the light image background.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle shadow or border to the badge and keep its inset consistent with the card padding.

issues.description: The heart/favorite button on the dark food images has low contrast. It is a dark translucent circle over a dark photo, especially on the ramen card.
issues.suggestion: Use a lighter translucent background or a stronger outline so the favorite control stands out.
